# Keyboard shortcuts

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.js from the shortcut list in app/parts/06-io.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

On a Mac, use Cmd where this page says Ctrl. Press **F1** at any time to open this help.

| Keys | What they do |
| --- | --- |
| 1 / 2 / 3 | Photo, Mix and Text views |
| H | Move around |
| Z | Zoom tool |
| C | Crop |
| W | Magic wand |
| L | Lasso |
| B | Selection brush |
| V | Select objects |
| U | Shapes |
| T | Text |
| P | Pen |
| N | Pencil |
| A | Edit points of lines |
| Shift / Alt | Add to or subtract from a selection |
| Alt drag | Copy objects while moving |
| Arrows | Nudge objects, Shift for 10 px |
| Space | Hold to move with any tool |
| Enter | Finish a pen line, apply a crop |
| Delete | Delete the selected object, line or point |
| Alt while dragging | Move freely, without snapping |
| Shift while drawing | Straight lines in 15° steps |
| Ctrl K | Find any command |
| Ctrl O | Open an image or a project |
| Ctrl A | Select all shapes |
| Ctrl ; | Snapping on or off |
| Ctrl ' | Show the grid |
| Ctrl C / V | Copy and paste objects |
| Ctrl D | Deselect |
| Ctrl J | Duplicate objects or text layer |
| Ctrl Z | Undo |
| Shift Ctrl Z | Redo |
| Ctrl S | Save project |
| Ctrl E | Export menu |
| Ctrl + / − / 0 | Zoom in, out, fit |
| Ctrl 1 / 2 | Actual size, zoom to selection |
| Ctrl scroll or pinch | Smooth zoom |
| Shift N | New artboard |
| / | Compare with a divider |
| Hold \ | Show the original photo |
| F1 | Help and tutorial |
| Esc | Cancel, close menus |
